name: hud_ui_element_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: HudUiElement::ScalarDeletingDestructor resets base dispatch state, optionally deletes self for flags bit 0, and returns self.
known_limits: Binary Ninja currently names the function HudUiCommon::ScalarDeletingDestructor, but the authored source and source-file map identify the implementation as HudUiElement::ScalarDeletingDestructor.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x404d70 validates reading the low byte of the flags argument, resetting this object's dispatch pointer to the HudUiElement base state, conditionally calling operator delete when flags bit 0 is set, and returning this.
The native smoke checks the no-delete path returns self and resets base dispatch state, then checks the heap scalar-delete path returns the original pointer value.
